info.name: HK Horse Racing API
info.description:
Express API exposing the HK horse racing tools (`analyze-race`, `backtest-differentiation`, `batch-analyze`) as JSON.

**Setup**
1. Start the server: `npm run dev:api` (reads `.env`).
2. Import this collection and an environment from `docs/`:
   - `hk-horse-racing-api.local.postman_environment.json` — your key from `.env` (gitignored, local only)
   - `hk-horse-racing-api.postman_environment.json` — template; paste a key from `API_KEYS` into `apiKey`
3. Select the environment. Every request sends `x-api-key: {{apiKey}}` (auth is set on the collection) to `{{baseUrl}}`.

**Caching** — the analysis endpoints are synchronous and cache results in `data/analysis/`. Synchronous. `"cache": "miss"` = ran now and saved; `"cache": "hit"` = returned the saved file immediately and refreshed it in the background. A saved file made with different options counts as a miss. Live scraping can take minutes: keep Postman's request timeout at 0 (no timeout).

**Errors** — JSON: 400 `invalid_request` (with `details`), 401 `unauthorized`, 404 `not_found` / `race_not_found`, 500 `internal_error`.

exec: console.warn("Select an environment that sets baseUrl and apiKey (docs/*.postman_environment.json)");

request.description:
Liveness check. Needs the API key like every other route.

Response: `{ status, uptime, timestamp, version }`.

item.name: Race analysis
item.description:
Runs the `tools/analyze-race.ts` pipeline for one race and returns JSON.

| Field | Required | Default | CLI flag |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | yes | — | `--date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |
| `venue` | yes | — | `--venue` (`ST`, `HV`, `Sha Tin`, `Happy Valley`) |
| `race` | yes | — | `--race` (1–14) |
| `formData` | no | `"venue"` | `--form-data all` → `"all"` |
| `useSaved` | no | `false` | `--use-saved` |
| `bankroll` | no | `10000` | `--bankroll` |
| `kellyFraction` | no | `0.25` | `--kelly` |
| `minEdge` | no | `5` | `--min-edge` |
| `ignoreRecords` | no | `[]` | `--ignore-records` (as an array) |

Response: `{ cache, generatedAt, params, result }`. `result` holds `race`, `config`, `runners`, `simulation`, `analysis`, `recommendations`, `exotics` (top 20 quinella / quinella place / trio / tierce), `finishTimes`, `marketEfficiency`.

Synchronous. `"cache": "miss"` = ran now and saved; `"cache": "hit"` = returned the saved file immediately and refreshed it in the background. A saved file made with different options counts as a miss.

Cache file: `data/analysis/<ST|HV>-<date>-<race>.json`. Errors: 400 `invalid_request`, 404 `race_not_found`.

exec: pm.test("reports cache hit or miss", () => pm.expect(["hit", "miss"]).to.include(json.cache));

request.description: Uses the saved race card snapshot in `data/racecards/` — fast (~1 s), works after race day.

item.name: Backtests
item.description:
Runs `tools/backtest-differentiation.ts` over saved racecards that have results. Every field is optional; defaults match the CLI.

| Field | Default | CLI flag |
|---|---|---|
| `sparseMax` | `3` | `--sparse` |
| `closeMax` | `4` | `--close` |
| `avgDiffMin` | `14` | `--avgdiff` |
| `gapMin` | `0` | `--gap` |
| `oddsMax` | `0` (off) | `--odds` |
| `ratingChangeMin` | `-1` (`null` = off) | `--ratingchange` |
| `months` | `[]` (all) | `--months` (as an array, e.g. `["08","09"]`) |
| `venue` | `null` (both) | `--venue` (`ST` / `HV`) |
| `surface` | `null` (both) | `--surface` (`Turf` / `AWT`) |
| `ignoreClasses` | `[]` | `--ignore-class` (as an array) |
| `ignoreDistances` | `[]` | `--ignore-distance` (array of metres) |
| `maxRating` | `0` (off) | `--max-rating` |
| `maxAvgDiff` | `0` (off) | `--max-avgdiff` |
| `form` | `"all"` | `--form` (`all` / `ST` / `HV`) |
| `ignoreAfter` | `null` | `--ignore-after` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |

`result` holds `totals`, `races`, `byDay`, `byMonth`, `breakdowns`, `classDistanceVenue`, `skipReasons` and `upcoming`. Percentages are numbers, `null` when there were no bets. Takes ~5–15 s on a miss.

Synchronous. `"cache": "miss"` = ran now and saved; `"cache": "hit"` = returned the saved file immediately and refreshed it in the background. A saved file made with different options counts as a miss.

Cache file: `data/analysis/backtest-differentiation-<hash>.json` (one per option set).

exec: pm.test("reports cache hit or miss", () => pm.expect(["hit", "miss"]).to.include(json.cache));

request.description: Same as `npx tsx tools/backtest-differentiation.ts` with no flags (both venues).

item.name: Batch analyses
item.description:
Runs `tools/batch-analyze.ts` for a meeting and returns every race as JSON. Unlike the CLI it does not write `data/temp/simulation_summaries_*.md`.

| Field | Required | Default | CLI flag |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | yes | — | `-d` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |
| `venue` | yes | — | `-v` (`ST`, `HV`, `Sha Tin`, `Happy Valley`) |
| `firstRace`, `lastRace` | no | `1`, `11` | `-r 1-11` |
| `formData` | no | `"venue"` | `-f all` → `"all"` |
| `useSaved` | no | `false` | `--use-saved` |
| `backtestMonths` | no | `[]` (all) | `--backtest-months` (as an array) |

`result.races`: per race — top-rated horse, rating, avgDiff / close<8 / sparse / top gap, betting signal (🔴 / 🟡 / 🟢), historical place hit rates (text and numbers), confidence, every runner's MC win/place % and odds. `result.unavailable` lists races with no data.

Synchronous. `"cache": "miss"` = ran now and saved; `"cache": "hit"` = returned the saved file immediately and refreshed it in the background. A saved file made with different options counts as a miss.

Cache file: `data/analysis/batch-<ST|HV>-<date>-R<first>-<last>.json`.

exec: pm.test("reports cache hit or miss", () => pm.expect(["hit", "miss"]).to.include(json.cache));
